Elaine (security): :rotating_light: Heads-up: new enforcement for privileged session age is rolling out. Effective in 7 days, any service credential or human session older than 90 days will be automatically flagged and then revoked unless an exception is approved. Were doing this to reduce blast radius from leaked long-lived creds. Read quick actions below and follow up if you own infra or service accounts.

Mike (sre): Quick q — will CI runners or Vault short-lived tokens be impacted?

Sanjay (infra): Short-lived tokens issued via vault/oidc (<=24h) are NOT affected. This only targets legacy long-lived service keys (created via `iam-service-keys` or manual uploads). If your service uses a short-lived flow, nothing to do.

Tara (eng): If my job uses a deploy key thats >90d and rotates nightly, do I need to do anything manually?

Sanjay (infra): If the key is actually rotated automatically and the created/issued credential is within 90d, no action. The scanner checks the creation timestamp on the credential record. If you have custom jobs that keep a single static key, rotate to oidc or a short-lived token.

Elaine (security): Action items (TL;DR):
- Owners of service accounts and any static deploy keys: identify keys >90d and rotate to short-lived tokens or new keys within 7 days.
- If you need an exception, open a ticket with tag `sec:exception` and include justification, owner, and expiration (max 30d).
- Run the discovery command below to find candidates.

Sanjay (infra): Example discovery command (use in your infra account):
```bash
# list service keys created >90 days ago (example)
rwdctl auth list-service-keys --min-age 90d --format json | jq -r '.[] | "id:\(.id) owner:\(.owner) created:\(.created)"'
```

Mike (sre): Where do we document the exception process and timeline?

Elaine (security): Runbook & exception form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/privileged-session-policy (internal). Exceptions are approved by SRE + Security and expire automatically. Enforcement schedule: nightly scanner starts tomorrow; automated revocations begin 7 days from now.

sec-bot: Automation notice: nightly token-scanner job will run at 02:00 UTC. First full report posted to #eng-security and ticketed owners at 1839006000.

Tara (eng): I'll audit our service-account repo later today and open tickets for any manual rotations needed.

Mike (sre): I'll coordinate with platform teams to ensure jobs that need allowlists are documented.

Elaine (security): Thanks — owners please complete rotations or exception requests by 2026-03-30. If you hit any blocker, ping me or open a hot ticket with `sec:urgent`. :white_check_mark:
